page_data.en:
師律夫關楊比
I. I. PIANKOFF
BARRISTER AT LAW
118. ROUTE VALLON. HOUSE 10
Telephone 81094

SHANGHAI, 4th April 1940
Office Hours: 9-7 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. P. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. ____
Date ____
PA
Ack 5 s/p

To Major K.M. Bourne,
Commissioner of S.M.P.
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to address to you with kind request
to inform me, if you will find that it is possible to
accomplish, about an address of Mr.Voldemar Dorf, which
has been sought by his wife Mrs. Vera Dorf, Russian Emig-
rant; for the purpose that Mrs.V.Dorf wishes to get divorce
from her husband.

For your guideness I beg to acknowledge you that accord-
ing to judgement of District Court for the First Special
area in Shanghai of 16th June 1939 Mr.V.Dorf was condemned
to three months of imprisonment.

I have take the care of interests of Mrs.V.Dorf as her
lawyer; the address of Mrs. Dorf 697/15 Ave.Joffre, Room 15.

Thanking you, Sir, in anticipation for your kind advice
and oblige.

Yours faithfully,

Barrister at Law.
I. Piankoff

Dc (Sp Br)
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE nB 5 APR. 1940）

师律夫关杨比
I. I. 皮扬科夫 (I. I. PIANKOFF)
律师
法租界华山路（Route Vallon）118号10室
电话 81094

上海，1940年4月4日
办公时间：9-7 上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. M. P. 登记处
编号 S. B. D. ____
日期 ____
PA
Ack 5 s/p

致 K.M. 伯恩少校，
上海公共租界工部局警务处处长，
上海。

先生：

谨致函阁下，恳请惠示，如蒙查办可行，请告知沃尔德马·多尔夫 (Voldemar Dorf) 先生之下落地址；此系其妻薇拉·多尔夫 (Vera Dorf) 夫人（俄籍流亡者）所查询，旨在与其丈夫离婚。

为供阁下参考，谨此奉告，根据1939年6月16日上海第一特区地方法院之判决，V. 多尔夫先生被判处三个月监禁。

本人作为 V. 多尔夫夫人之律师，负责维护其权益；多尔夫夫人住址为霞飞路 (Ave. Joffre) 697/15号15室。

预先感谢阁下之赐教与协助。

此致
敬礼

律师
I. 皮扬科夫 (I. Piankoff)

Dc (Sp Br)
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 nB 1940年4月5日）

D. 9933

**〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写批注〕**

April 9, 40.

I. Piankoff, Esq.,
Barrister-At-Law,
118, Route Vallon, House 10,
SHANGHAI.

Sir,

In reply to your letter dated April 4th 1940,
I have to state that the whereabouts of Voldemar Dorf
are unknown to this Police Force.

I am, Sir,
Yours obedient servant,

Sd. K. M. Bourne.
Commissioner of Police.

CCK/.

**〔此处转录不清：左下角手写批注〕**

此致
敬礼
